bugs_found: loan_payment accepts negative principal and returns negative payments instead of rejecting invalid loan amounts
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float inputs can pass validation then fail arithmetic at runtime
transfer mutates account_from before updating account_to; if crediting account_to fails, funds are debited without rollback
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive/finite, allowing zero, negative, NaN, or infinite FX rates
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds via int(), changing requested terms without error
money amounts are never quantized to currency minor units, causing fractional-cent balances/payments/fees to propagate
functions do not consistently reject NaN/Infinity for amounts, rates, balances, or fees
